data.desc: DiamondRock Hospitality Company (Nasdaq: DRH) is a self-advised real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns a leading portfolio of geographically diversified hotels concentrated in leisure destinations and top gateway markets. The Company owns 36 premium-quality hotels and resorts with 9,644 rooms. The Company has strategically positioned its portfolio to be operated under leading global brand families and independent boutique hotels in the lifestyle segment.
